description: Sonosphere: use origin edge TTLs for anonymous homepage and artist content
expression: (http.host eq "sonosphere.fm" and ((http.request.uri.query eq "" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/music/"))) or http.request.uri.path in {"/api/home" "/api/artist" "/api/artist/tracks" "/api/artist/albums" "/api/artist/similar" "/api/artist/listeners"})) and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not (http.cookie contains "sid=" or http.cookie contains "act_as=" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") or http.request.headers.truncated)

description: Sonosphere: bypass authenticated homepage and artist content
expression: (http.host eq "sonosphere.fm" and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/music/")) or http.request.uri.path in {"/api/home" "/api/artist" "/api/artist/tracks" "/api/artist/albums" "/api/artist/similar" "/api/artist/listeners"})) and (http.cookie contains "sid=" or http.cookie contains "act_as=" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") or http.request.headers.truncated)
